submission.justification: D1 has the highest raw light yield but fails thermal cycling (30% vs the 5% limit), and failed modules can't be replaced. Of the two designs that pass, D2 gives more light than D3 (38.5 vs 25.3 PE/MeV at 30%). 30% coverage is the maximum allowed, and the feedthroughs support it. D2's 2% failure rate is from a batch of 40, so it is about one module and carries some statistical uncertainty.

requirements.evidence: D2 at 30% gives 38.54 PE/MeV, the highest among designs that pass the thermal requirement. D3 gives 25.34.
D2 failed 2% (about 1 of 40 modules). D1 failed 30% and is excluded.
30% chosen. Feedthroughs are available for up to 30%.

requirements.requirement: One of the three listed designs
